title: [CQ-C01] Compact context packet
description:

Deliverable: Compact context packet. This is task C01 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): F06.

Cases (whole-object assertions on the manifest wherever it is deterministic):
1. DoD1, required fields survive role trimming.
   - For every caller, in both the default and full views, every MANDATORY_SECTIONS path the task has is present with its stored value (toStrictEqual against the stored task/epic/project).
   - packetManifest.sections lists each of them as {path, mandatory:true, status:'served'}.
   - QA and worker trims appear as {path, mandatory:false, status:'omitted', reason:'role-trim'}.
   - No ROLE_OMITTED entry (exported from getContext.ts) is a mandatory path.
2. Missing mandatory facts are explicit. A PLANNING task with an empty DoD, no plan and no executionContract lists those paths as status 'missing' (reason 'empty' or 'not-set'), with complete:false. Nothing is invented.
3. Explicit omissions:
   - comments beyond commentsLimit give {path:'task.comments', mandatory:false, status:'truncated', reason:'compacted', count};
   - more than 20 commits give task.commits 'capped' with the overflow count;
   - a chat message over the chat character cap gives chat.recentMessages 'truncated';
   - complete is false;
   - limitations is sorted and includes 'no-repository-source'.
4. DoD2, budget.
   - A default read gives budget {limitChars: DEFAULT_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS, mandatoryChars > 0, status:'within'}.
   - packetBudgetChars below mandatoryChars gives status 'overflow' and requirement 'expand', while task.description, definitionOfDone, implementationPlan and executionContract stay byte-equal to the stored values (never truncated).
   - A plan of 30 steps x 9000 chars gives requirement 'restructure', even at packetBudgetChars = MAX, and is still served whole.
   - packetBudgetChars of 0, -1, 1.5, '100', null or MAX+1 is refused INVALID_INPUT before any write (contextFetchedBy and attempt bytes unchanged), in both the default and status views.
5. DoD3, packet identity never grants approval.
   - The manifest's key set is exactly {version, provenance, sections, complete, limitations, budget}: no approval, authorization or readiness field.
   - A recorded read (the worker owning a running attempt, plus sessionId) leaves Task.approvedPlanRevision unchanged.
   - Its servedContext.packetId equals the sha256 of JSON.stringify(response minus servedContext), INCLUDING packetManifest.
   - On a strict row (planRevision 4, approvedPlanRevision 3; follow the F07 startStepAuthorization.test.ts pattern), a recorded read followed by start_step with the full identity is still refused PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED.
6. view:'status' is unchanged: it has no packetManifest key.

implementationPlan.description:
NEW packages/moe-daemon/src/context/contextPacket.ts. It is pure: no state, no IO, no writes.

Exports:
- MANDATORY_SECTIONS = ['project.globalRails', 'allRails', 'task.description', 'task.definitionOfDone', 'task.taskRails', 'task.implementationPlan', 'task.executionContract'].
  - Plus a conditional 'task.requiredCheckSnapshot': it is listed as served only when present and is never reported missing.
- DEFAULT_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS 100000, MIN_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS 1000, MAX_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS 250000.
- readPacketBudgetChars(value): undefined returns DEFAULT. Anything else must be a safe integer in [MIN, MAX], else invalidInput('packetBudgetChars', ...). Strict, never clamped. Do NOT use normalizeIntegerOption, which clamps.
- Types:
  - PacketSection {path; mandatory: boolean; status; reason?: string; count?: number}. status is 'served' | 'truncated' | 'omitted' | 'missing': reuse C02's SourceItemStatus from context/repositorySource.ts (Extract<...>) rather than defining a parallel vocabulary.
  - PacketManifest {version: 1; provenance: {task: {id; planRevision: number | null}; epic: {id} | null; project: {id}; candidate?: {id}}; sections; complete: boolean; limitations: string[]; budget: {limitChars; mandatoryChars; status: 'within' | 'overflow'; requirement?: 'expand' | 'restructure'}}.
- buildPacketManifest(body, input). body is the assembled get_context response, without the manifest or servedContext. input is {planRevision: number | null, roleOmitted: string[], siblingsBeyondCap: number, commitsTotal: number, rejectionsTotal: number, budgetChars: number}.

What buildPacketManifest does:
- Mandatory sections. Read each path with a tiny own-property path reader (hasOwnProperty per segment, never an inherited key).
  - A section is served when present and non-empty: a non-blank string, a non-empty array (taskRails is served whenever it is an array), or an object.
  - Otherwise it is missing, with reason 'not-set' (absent) or 'empty'.
  - mandatoryChars is the sum of JSON.stringify(value).length over the served mandatory sections.
- Optional sections are reported only when not served in full:
  - each roleOmitted path: omitted, 'role-trim';
  - task.comments: truncated, 'compacted', count = commentSummary.omitted + commentSummary.truncated, when above 0;
  - chat.recentMessages: truncated, 'compacted', count = the number of contentTruncated messages;
  - task.commits: truncated, 'capped', count = commitsTotal minus the served length;
  - task.epicSiblings: truncated, 'capped', count = siblingsBeyondCap, only when not role-trimmed;
  - task.rejectionHistory: truncated, 'capped', count = total minus served.
- Sort sections by path. complete is true only when every section is served.
- limitations, sorted and unique: always 'no-repository-source' (C10 later serves C02's provider), plus 'plan-revision-unreadable' when planRevision is null.
- Budget: 'within' when mandatoryChars <= budgetChars. Otherwise 'overflow', with requirement 'expand' when mandatoryChars <= MAX, else 'restructure'.
  - Error handling here is reporting, never truncation: the manifest only measures and reports, and nothing served is removed or shortened.
- Provenance: the ids come from body.project, epic and task, planRevision from input, and the candidate id when body.currentCandidate exists.
- No approval, authorization or readiness field, ever (DoD3).

Keep the module at about 110 lines or fewer.

implementationPlan.description:
Wire the manifest into packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getContext.ts, turning step 1 GREEN.
1. inputSchema: add an optional packetBudgetChars (integer, minimum MIN_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS, maximum MAX_PACKET_BUDGET_CHARS) with a description.
2. Extend the tool description by one sentence:
   - default and full task reads include packetManifest: mandatory sections that are never role-trimmed or truncated, explicit omissions, limitations, provenance, and a budget that answers an overflow with an expand or restructure requirement;
   - it never grants approval.
3. Validate with readPacketBudgetChars right after readContextSessionId. That is BEFORE the status early return and before any write, so a bad value is refused in every view without stamping contextFetchedBy.
4. `export` ROLE_OMITTED.
5. Compute siblingsBeyondCap from the same lower-order filter that builds baseSiblings: max(0, length - MAX_EPIC_SIBLINGS). The served sibling list stays unchanged.
6. Name the assembled object `body`.
   - When a task exists: `const packet = { ...body, packetManifest: buildPacketManifest(body, { planRevision, roleOmitted: omitted, siblingsBeyondCap, commitsTotal: commits.length, rejectionsTotal: task.rejectionHistory?.length ?? 0, budgetChars }) }`. planRevision is read through the existing `decoded(unreadable, 'planRevision', () => decodeStoredPlanRevision(task))` guard, so an unreadable value is served as null and never thrown.
   - Pass `packet` to servedContextIdentity unchanged, so the manifest falls under the F06 digest.
   - The no-task path still returns body. view:'status' is untouched.
   - Every existing key, value and order stays as it is: legacy readers see one additive key.
Do not touch startStep, the attempt store or the wrappers.

The F06 plan (rev 1, now WORKING) fixes the packet identity this task extends. Re-verify against the landed F06 code before planning. Serena memory: decision-served-context-receipt.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. Duplicate the mandatory contract into a separate packet object: rejected. That doubles tokens (CQ-TOKEN rails), since the fields already sit in the response. The manifest references paths instead.
2. Put the manifest inside servedContext: rejected. servedContext is outside F06's digest, and the manifest must be digested.
3. Trim optional sections to fit the budget now: rejected for C01. It changes legacy payloads, and DoD2 only forbids silent MANDATORY truncation. The budget measures the mandatory contract and answers expand or restructure; optional trimming can come with C06/C10.
4. Clamp packetBudgetChars with normalizeIntegerOption: rejected, because it coerces. The value is refused instead.
5. Define a new status vocabulary: rejected. The manifest reuses C02's SourceItemStatus subset (per architect-26ba32c3's note).
6. Put identity in the manifest: rejected. servedContext already carries task, attempt and revision on every task read; duplicating it inside the digest adds bytes for no binding gain, because the receipt binds packetId with identity.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- get_context already never truncates the DoD, plan or contract at read time. Write-time caps apply instead (step description 10000, DoD 50x1000).
- Existing compaction: comments via commentSummary, chat at 1000 chars per 10 messages, siblings capped at 20, commits capped at 20, rejectionHistory capped at 5. These become explicit sections.
- ROLE_OMITTED: qa drops task.epicSiblings, planningNotes and routing; worker drops routing.
- executionContract is already commented 'never role-trimmed' (F03).
- F06: packetId = sha256 of JSON.stringify of the response minus servedContext, so a manifest added before servedContextIdentity is digested automatically.
- normalizeIntegerOption clamps; it is not a validator.
- getContext tests assert specific fields rather than whole payloads, so one additive key is low-churn.
planningNotes.risks:
- getContext.ts overlaps CQ-V01's stale plan (task-bde86540, PLANNING, unassigned). V01 is set to dependsOn C01 per the serialize rail.
- A legacy task without executionContract reports it missing ('not-set'). That is honest and intended, and it makes complete:false common.
- Every default/full read grows by the manifest (hundreds of chars). Keep it to paths, codes and counts.
- The wrappers inject get_context into prompts (F10/F11 own transport). The manifest must stay deterministic so the prompt cache is not churned beyond the existing per-read fields.
- QA cap: 400 net LOC or less including tests.
- The gate must run in the Linux snapshot with env -i.
- Never spell the project's forbidden-pattern tokens.

- Keys: exactly {version:1, provenance, sections, complete, limitations, budget}. There is no approval, authorization or readiness key.
- provenance: {task:{id, planRevision|null}, epic:{id}|null, project:{id}, candidate?:{id}}.
- sections[]: {path, mandatory, status served|truncated|omitted|missing, reason?, count?}, sorted by path.
  - Mandatory paths: project.globalRails, allRails, task.description, task.definitionOfDone, task.taskRails, task.implementationPlan, task.executionContract, plus task.requiredCheckSnapshot when present.
  - absent or null gives missing 'not-set'; blank or empty gives missing 'empty'. An empty taskRails array counts as served.
- Optional sections are listed only when not served in full, with exact counts: 'role-trim' (omitted), comments and chat 'compacted', and commits, epicSiblings and rejectionHistory 'capped'. The epicSiblings count includes only lower-order siblings that are past the 20 cap and are not declared targets, because declared targets are still served.
- complete means every section is served.
- limitations: 'no-repository-source' (until C10) and 'plan-revision-unreadable'.
- budget: {limitChars, mandatoryChars, status within|overflow, requirement expand|restructure}. Input packetBudgetChars defaults to 100000 and must be a safe integer in 1000
